summary: Quantifies and visualizes the evolution, emergence, and diversification of hierarchical cell clusters and subclusters across developmental time points.
use_when: How do cell cluster counts change across mouse visual cortex development?
Visualize the temporal dynamics of cell-type subclusters in developmental atlas data.
Track cell type lineage and branching from embryonic to postnatal stages.
Quantify the diversification of neural identities over the developmental timeline.
Generate alluvial diagrams for hierarchical cell cluster trajectories.
avoid_when: A low-dimensional embedding alone would be treated as confirmatory statistical evidence
